name: why-cards
description: Centred heading over three linked use-case glass cards on a brand splash (indigo / teal orbs on white, fading out at the edges). Live: the .epx-why section on the solution pages, Emergency Preparedness, School Reunification and Help Desk (rules ported).

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens), e.g. purchasing-partners on Partners.

title.description: Heading. Optional when groups carry the section (Purchasing Contracts): the head then shows only what is set.

items.description: Cards. Each: title (line breaks kept) and body (line breaks kept, **bold**); optional url (links the title), link_label (with url: an arrow link under the body carries the url instead of the title), links (several arrow links at the foot, each label and url; Partners: View / Email Carahsoft), logo (a partner logo in a white box above the title) with logo_alt, logo_w, logo_h, icon (image URL) or icon_svg (inline SVG), icon_alt.

variant.description: All variants: glass cards over the splash. solution: the six solution pages. readiness: deeper bottom space, still icons (Emergency Preparedness, School Reunification). service: shallow bottom space (Help Desk).

columns.description: 0: every card in one row (today's three-card band). 2 or 3: the cards wrap into a grid that many columns wide from 1001px (24px gaps; two columns from 641px, one below), for more than three cards, e.g. the Compare hub's six industry cards (Figma 7379:184440). A short last row is centred (five cards: three over two).

groups.description: Labelled card groups after items, all in the one section over the one splash (Purchasing Contracts: State, Local & Education / Federal / International). Each: heading (drawn as the eyebrow label, an h2 when the section has no title, else an h3), optional anchor (id), items (as above). Laid out by columns.

note.description: Small print centred under the cards (Partners: confirm availability and pricing with the partner).
